pairs.story: Adam and Brian met in a long comment thread about faith and economics and kept arguing in DMs. Adam enjoys Brian more than Brian enjoys being argued with.
Adam and Kendra got to know each other in the comments under one of her fitness-tracker reviews. He keeps asking her for half-marathon advice, and she answers in one word.
Kristen was the RA on Adam's freshman floor at Illinois Wesleyan, and they have talked every week since. She calls him her little brother, and he argues with her about everything.
Adam and Ryan met in the comments under Sarah's posts. Ryan thinks Adam is brilliant, and Adam likes him fine and takes the other side of his takes.
Adam rented the other unit of Sarah's Lakeview two-flat for years, and they still have dinner monthly. He takes the other side of everything she says, and she lets him.
Amanda started following Andre after one of his posts about front porches spread around, and she argues with his preservation takes. He finds her a good sport.
Amanda and Gary met in a Chicago-area Facebook group, where they agree about Gen Z and nothing else. His comments on her posts run a little too warm.
Amanda knows Jake as the coworker who roasts her brother's cars online. She laughs, then tells him to knock it off.
Ryan was Dale's roommate at Purdue and comments on everything Amanda posts. She likes him a lot and plays devil's advocate on his takes anyway.
Amra and Daniel met in a comment war about Red Stars coverage on his station's page. She likes that he brings sources, and he likes her more than she likes most people.
Amra and Deepa met in a Chicago dog owners' group, and Amra now texts her about every limp of Lucy, her golden retriever. Deepa answers in one dry sentence.
Andre and Daniel got to know each other when Andre called in to Daniel's show about stadium plans. They argue Sox and Cubs and ballpark architecture online.
Andre answered Donna's question about bungalow brickwork in a Facebook group two years ago, and she adopted him. He sketches her block from photos she sends.
Brian and Daniel met in a thread about faith and sports. Daniel argues with him politely and at length, and Brian answers with puns.
Brian leaves earnest, kind comments on Kendra's posts. His kindness irritates her, and she has told him so.
Cody and Jesse bonded online over growing up thirty miles apart downstate. Cody has offered to help name the Mustang.
Jessica's parents live three streets from Deepa in Naperville, and Jessica drives Mabel out for checkups because she trusts nobody else. They like each other in a quiet, practical way.
Kristen lives next door to Deepa in Naperville, adores her and brings food she didn't ask for. Deepa is fond of her and wishes she would knock.
Ryan sold Deepa's clinic its software and stayed in touch. He asks her about dogs, and she answers as if he were a client.
Deepa and Sarah sit next to each other at Red Stars matches. Sarah talks, Deepa listens, and both of them like it that way.
Donna thinks Jake is hilarious, and he likes her food posts more than he admits. She is the one person whose comments he never needles.
Eleni bought a vintage Bulls jersey from Jake's side hustle for one of her boys and now thinks he's the funniest rude boy she knows. He tolerates her emojis.
Eleni sold Kendra her Oak Park condo and still checks in on her. Kendra appreciates her and ignores the bone-broth advice.
Eleni and Kristen met in a suburban moms' group online and cheer each other's posts. Kristen thinks Eleni is glamorous; Eleni thinks Kristen needs a nap.
Eleni stopped into Oksana's bar after showing a Ukrainian Village condo and has been back since. Oksana likes her, and Eleni finds Oksana a lot.
Eleni sold Sam and Jim their Berwyn bungalow and keeps asking how the kitchen is going. Sam is grateful and could do without the emojis.
Kristen grew up on Gary's Berwyn block, and he taught her to ride a bike. He still calls her 'kiddo' in her comments.
Gary did the piping on a Kinzie Freight expansion years ago and has been friends with Marko since. They trade stories about jobs that went wrong.
Jake and Lukas met reselling sneakers online and roast each other's side hustles. Lukas likes Jake more than Jake admits liking anyone.
Jesse asks Kendra gym questions in her comments, and she answers bluntly. It amuses her more than she'll admit.
Jessica and Kendra run into each other in online threads. Jessica thinks Kendra is funny; Kendra finds Jessica's puns exhausting.
Jessica and Nick met at Tim's Fourth of July cookout last summer and got along right away. They're friendly in each other's comments.
Kendra checked Marko over at Prairie Path after his kitchen fire, and he still tells people she's the best. She finds him entertaining in small doses.
Kendra met Tim through Megan at a Prairie Path fundraiser and they keep up online. He likes arguing with her, and she likes him a little less than he thinks.
Rick rewired Kristen's basement a few years ago and is now family. She sends Maribel recipes, and he sends her photos from his smoker.
Lisa met Sam when Frank spent a week at Prairie Path after a heart scare and Sam explained everything twice. They've been friends ever since.
Marko watched Nick's engine company put out his kitchen fire and still tells the story. Nick stops by Kinzie Freight when he's in the area.
Megan and Oksana met at Oksana's bar after one of Megan's night shifts and became friends. Oksana pours, and Megan vents.
